kinds.d: Drill driver with an added hammer action and an ordinary chuck, for drilling masonry as well as wood and metal.
Hand-held power driver with a rotary impact mechanism and a quarter-inch hex bit holder, for driving long screws.
Hand-held tool with an electro-pneumatic hammer mechanism and an SDS-type bit holder, for heavy drilling and chiselling in masonry.
Power wrench with an impact mechanism and a square drive, for sockets on heavy nuts and bolts.
Small powered driver for light screwdriving, without an impact mechanism.
Powered tool that drives a chisel or point by hammer blows alone, without rotation, to break concrete, masonry and tile.
Portable drill press on an electromagnetic base that clamps to steel, usually with annular cutters.
